convert_diffusers_lora_to_webui: run the script to convert a diffusers SDXL LoRA safetensors file to Kohya format for WebUI use
convert_and_save_function: call convert_and_save to load a diffusers LoRA, convert it to Kohya format, and save the output file
convert_lora_for_automatic1111: convert a diffusers trained SDXL LoRA to a format compatible with AUTOMATIC1111 WebUI
convert_lora_for_comfyui: convert a diffusers trained SDXL LoRA to a format compatible with ComfyUI
run_lora_conversion_cli: run the CLI with --input_lora and optional --output_lora flags to convert a LoRA model file
